#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publication-quality gradient analysis figure for OccSafe-VLA paper."""
import json, os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 9,
    "axes.titlesize": 10, "axes.labelsize": 9,
    "xtick.labelsize": 8, "ytick.labelsize": 8,
    "legend.fontsize": 7.5, "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300, "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
    "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.5,
})

COLORS = {
    "Vanilla": "#888888",
    "Full OCC": "#0072B2",
    "Random OCC": "#009E73",
    "Detach": "#CC3311",
}
KEY_DINO = [0, 4, 8, 12, 17, 22]
KEY_SIGLIP = [0, 8, 16, 25]

def load(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)

def val(data, layer, field, sub="mean"):
    return data.get("layers", {}).get(layer, {}).get(field, {}).get(sub, 0.0)

def main():
    base = "/root/occsafe_vla/analysis/results/gradient"
    out = "/root/occsafe_vla/artifacts/figures"
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)

    D = {
        "Vanilla": load(f"{base}/vanilla_gradient_stats.json"),
        "Full OCC": load(f"{base}/full_occ_gradient_stats.json"),
        "Random OCC": load(f"{base}/random_occ_gradient_stats.json"),
        "Detach": load(f"{base}/detach_gradient_stats.json"),
    }

    layers = [f"dino_{i}" for i in KEY_DINO] + [f"siglip_{i}" for i in KEY_SIGLIP]
    labels = [f"D{i}" for i in KEY_DINO] + [f"S{i}" for i in KEY_SIGLIP]
    x = np.arange(len(layers))
    sep = len(KEY_DINO) - 0.5
    n_lay = len(layers)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10.5, 7.5))

    # ---- (a) Action gradient norms ----
    ax = axes[0, 0]
    w = 0.18
    cond_order = ["Vanilla", "Full OCC", "Random OCC", "Detach"]
    offsets = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]
    for cond, off in zip(cond_order, offsets):
        m = [val(D[cond], l, "action_grad_norm") for l in layers]
        s = [val(D[cond], l, "action_grad_norm", "std") for l in layers]
        ax.bar(x + off * w, m, w, yerr=s, label=cond,
               color=COLORS[cond], capsize=1.5, alpha=0.85,
               edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3,
               error_kw={"linewidth": 0.7})
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
    ax.set_ylabel("Gradient Norm")
    ax.set_title("(a) Action Gradient Norms per Layer")
    ax.legend(loc="upper left", framealpha=0.85, edgecolor="none")
    ax.axvline(sep, color="#bbb", ls=":", lw=0.7)
    yl = ax.get_ylim()
    ax.text(sep / 2, yl[1] * 0.93, "DINOv2", ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#999")
    ax.text((sep + n_lay) / 2, yl[1] * 0.93, "SigLIP", ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#999")

    # ---- (b) Auxiliary gradient norms ----
    ax = axes[0, 1]
    w2 = 0.32
    occ_conds = ["Full OCC", "Random OCC"]
    for i, cond in enumerate(occ_conds):
        m = [val(D[cond], l, "aux_grad_norm") for l in layers]
        s = [val(D[cond], l, "aux_grad_norm", "std") for l in layers]
        ax.bar(x + (i - 0.5) * w2, m, w2, yerr=s, label=cond,
               color=COLORS[cond], capsize=1.5, alpha=0.85,
               edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3,
               error_kw={"linewidth": 0.7})
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
    ax.set_ylabel("Gradient Norm")
    ax.set_title("(b) OCC Auxiliary Gradient Norms")
    ax.legend(loc="upper left", framealpha=0.85, edgecolor="none")
    ax.axvline(sep, color="#bbb", ls=":", lw=0.7)
    yl2 = ax.get_ylim()
    ax.text(sep / 2, yl2[1] * 0.93, "DINOv2", ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#999")
    ax.text((sep + n_lay) / 2, yl2[1] * 0.93, "SigLIP", ha="center", fontsize=7, color="#999")

    # ---- (c) Cosine similarity heatmap ----
    ax = axes[1, 0]
    cos = np.array([[val(D[c], l, "cosine_similarity") for l in layers]
                     for c in occ_conds])
    vabs = max(np.abs(cos).max(), 0.04)
    im = ax.imshow(cos, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-vabs, vmax=vabs, aspect="auto")
    ax.set_xticks(range(n_lay))
    ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=7)
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_yticklabels(occ_conds, fontsize=8)
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(n_lay):
            v = cos[i, j]
            c = "white" if abs(v) > vabs * 0.55 else "black"
            ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.3f}", ha="center", va="center",
                    fontsize=6.5, color=c, fontweight="medium")
    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label("Cosine Similarity", fontsize=7)
    ax.set_title("(c) Action–Auxiliary Gradient Cosine Similarity")

    # ---- (d) Gradient collapse ratio ----
    ax = axes[1, 1]
    v_norms = [val(D["Vanilla"], l, "action_grad_norm") for l in layers]
    d_norms = [val(D["Detach"], l, "action_grad_norm") for l in layers]
    ratios = [d / v if v > 1e-8 else 0 for d, v in zip(d_norms, v_norms)]

    bar_colors = [COLORS["Detach"] if r < 0.15 else "#E69F00" for r in ratios]
    bars = ax.bar(x, ratios, color=bar_colors, alpha=0.85,
                  edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3)
    ax.axhline(1.0, color="#888", ls="--", lw=0.8, label="No collapse (1.0)")
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
    ax.set_ylabel("Detach / Vanilla Ratio")
    ax.set_title("(d) Gradient Collapse (Detach vs. Vanilla)")
    top = max(ratios) * 1.6
    ax.set_ylim(0, max(top, 0.15))
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper right", framealpha=0.85, edgecolor="none")
    ax.axvline(sep, color="#bbb", ls=":", lw=0.7)
    for i, r in enumerate(ratios):
        ax.text(i, r + top * 0.02, f"{r:.2f}", ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=6, color="#333")

    plt.tight_layout(pad=1.8)
    for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
        p = os.path.join(out, f"gradient_analysis_combined.{ext}")
        fig.savefig(p, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
        print(f"Saved: {p}")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("Done.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
